_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 20: September 2025. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says the enemy will try to bring in fear through mass casualty shootings so that people do not want to come to the revival meetings ahead, and that this was the plan.
mentions.quote: bring in fear through mass casualty shootings
mentions.falsify_match: Mass shootings at or around large religious gatherings.

mentions.claim_text: He says he simply repeats what he hears and is not trying to rhyme or make a cute slogan, and that the Lord told him they must pray over the 2026 elections.
mentions.quote: I'm not trying to rhyme and it's not trying to be a cute slogan
mentions.falsify_match: Notable as a self-aware disclaimer about the rhyming year-words he uses elsewhere.

mentions.claim_text: He says September is a hot month, that he told them it was circled with a fog over it, that the Lord said they must pray over September, and that he has been warning since about March.
mentions.quote: September is a hot month. I told you it was circled with a fog over
mentions.falsify_match: Major events in September 2025, with a March origin locatable in the corpus.
mentions.falsify_miss: An unremarkable month, or no prior statement.

mentions.claim_text: He reports five major shakings coming: a shaking in the earth, in the heavens, in the political, in the finances and in the church, described as labour pains shaking in the natural.
mentions.quote: Five major shakings are co
mentions.falsify_match: All five domains in visible crisis at once.
mentions.falsify_miss: They are not, though no date is attached.

mentions.claim_text: He recommends reading Kenneth Hagin on the baptism of the Holy Ghost and speaking in tongues rather than having him explain everything, calling him a spiritual father.
mentions.quote: you find out about the baptism of the Holy Ghost through
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a reading recommendation.

mentions.claim_text: He calls prayer over Damascus concerning biological weapons and over Israel in the night hour, and says he has told them a ruinous heap, as the Bible says is coming, with something strategic involved.
mentions.quote: pray over Damascus, concerning these biological weapons
mentions.falsify_match: Damascus destroyed or rendered uninhabitable, with chemical or biological weapons involved.

mentions.claim_text: He says he feels an urgency, not pressure, to pray over the month of September, and that he will be back soon with another video.
mentions.quote: An urgency to pray over the month of September
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: framing.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats seeing Governor Stitt brought down and a Democrat trying to come in, and says the Lord called 2026 the year of a fix, which he does not understand and wonders whether it means a fixed or rigged election.
mentions.quote: the Lord said 2026 is the year of a fix. I don't know what that
mentions.falsify_match: A rigged or contested 2026 election, or a fixing of the economy ahead of it.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither, though he leaves the meaning of fix open himself.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying there are days ahead when everything will change in twenty four hours and America will change in twenty four hours, and that a great shaking is coming, warning again about the way people live and manoeuvre.
mentions.quote: everything in a 24h hour, I'm telling you, will change
mentions.falsify_match: A single day on which American life changes comprehensively.
mentions.falsify_miss: None, and no date is attached.

mentions.claim_text: He tells viewers to yield and ask to be filled and pray in tongues with him, because the Spirit will not come and wag your tongue for you.
mentions.quote: he's not going to come and wag your tongue for you
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is seeing food shortages again along with food and supply chain problems similar to April and the trade war, and that he called the China trade war months before it happened.
mentions.quote: I told you all months before trade war with China
mentions.falsify_match: A renewed supply chain and food availability crisis after September 2025.

mentions.claim_text: In discussion someone raises wormwood water and poison water, which he says he did not see, and they compare it with the calendar he saw in the last prayer session.
mentions.quote: Wormwood water. Poison water. You didn't see that
mentions.falsify_match: Worth keeping as a restraint: offered a bigger reading, he says he did not see it.

mentions.claim_text: He says he prefers books written by people who have actually been through something, because that wisdom changes your life, and questions books from people without the life experience.
mentions.quote: What life experiences do you have to write a book?
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an opinion about books.

mentions.claim_text: He notes constant ring of fire earthquakes suddenly stopping, asks whether that is their prayers or God waiting, says he feels something is about to happen, and asks how the UN handles Israel in the next stretch.
mentions.quote: is that our prayers or are you waiting I feel something is about to happen
mentions.falsify_match: A major earthquake following the lull, and a UN decision on Israel.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither, though he frames the lull itself as evidence either way.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a place with no darkness where the land is all split up and visible, says it is way out there, that it is glory and glorious, and that everyone who goes there will see it.
mentions.quote: There's no darkness but it's all split up and you can see the land
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a description of a place beyond this world.

mentions.claim_text: Reacting to news that something has passed clinical trials and will start being tested on people, he says that is exactly what they prophesied and that the Lord gave it to them in 2024.
mentions.quote: that's exactly what we prophesied. That's what the Lord gave us
mentions.falsify_match: The 2024 statement can be located in the corpus and matched to the trial now announced.

mentions.claim_text: He asks who is on God's side and who is on the Antichrist side, and says Macron rolling this out is coming just as the Lord said it would in the September to remember.
mentions.quote: coming like like the Lord told us it would in the month of September
mentions.falsify_match: The French recognition of a Palestinian state in September 2025, which occurred.

mentions.claim_text: He says that in February he prophesied a new foundation for a new industrial revolution being laid to bring in the beast system, with laws taking it out of the wild west into a modern society.
mentions.quote: a new foundation for a new industrial revolution to bring in the beast system
mentions.falsify_match: Regulatory frameworks for AI and digital assets consolidating into a single identity and payment system.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him specifically that if America divides it, it will happen in three days, and that he was not given that kind of stern warning about Canada.
mentions.quote: he said in three days if this is decide it will happen
mentions.condition_text: conditioned on America dividing the land
mentions.falsify_match: American backing for dividing Israel followed within three days by a judgment event.
mentions.falsify_miss: America divides it and nothing follows in three days.

mentions.claim_text: He says this is the time with no epidural, when the doctor says it is time to push, and that the Lord told him they are at the point of no return this September.
mentions.quote: this September he said you're at the point of no return
mentions.falsify_match: An irreversible turn dated to September 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He describes the calendar in the vision: the fog started on the 5th of September and thickened the further it went, and the month was circled in what looked like a bloodline, a circle of red.
mentions.quote: the fog started on the 5th and it went all the way through
mentions.falsify_match: Events escalating through September 2025 from the 5th onward, with bloodshed.

mentions.claim_text: He says there was a sandy haze over September running into October, that the word was given back around March, and that they have been praying over it since and are now here.
mentions.quote: it had a like a sandy haze all over uh September
mentions.falsify_match: The March origin can be located, which would make the September framing a genuine prior call.

mentions.claim_text: He says 2026 is the year of the fix in the sense of making the economy look amazing so everybody wants to vote red, and that he has seen a great shaking coming to New York because of the decisions they make.
mentions.quote: make it look like the economy is amazing so that everybody wants to vote red
mentions.falsify_match: A pre-midterm economic push in 2026 and a crisis in New York.

mentions.claim_text: He says what is sown here is reaped big in heaven, that he believes they will reap on earth too, and jokes about how good his house there will be.
mentions.quote: what we sow on this side, we're going to reap big in heaven
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a return payable in the next life.

mentions.claim_text: He says between them and the thousands watching, it was the glory that set off the fire alarm, while allowing that somebody could have pulled it.
mentions.quote: it was the glory that set off that fire alarm
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, though he supplies the mundane alternative himself.

mentions.claim_text: He says people have become desensitised to the coming of the Lord because they have heard it since the disciples, and that the Lord told him to raise his expectations.
mentions.quote: you become desensitized to the coming of the Lord
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and a rare acknowledgement that imminence claims have been made continuously for two thousand years.

mentions.claim_text: He works out that the blood moon falls tomorrow night on the sixth, and notes Trump posting on Truth Social that India, Russia and China are aligning.
mentions.quote: So, tomorrow night is the blood moon
mentions.falsify_match: Current events he ties together, not a forward claim.

mentions.claim_text: He thanks viewers for praying for a man's heart and says the Lord told them he sees breakthrough, tying it to the big decisions being made.
mentions.quote: the Lord told us I see breakthrough. I see breakthrough
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a private outcome for an unnamed person.

mentions.claim_text: He connects a post to what the Lord said in the video called a glimpse into 2026 and to the golden foundation, saying Trump was pointing at it.
mentions.quote: just like what the Lord said whenever he on that video, a glimpse into 2026
mentions.falsify_match: The glimpse into 2026 video is in the corpus and its content is checkable against 2026.

mentions.claim_text: He says he has expectation for the rest of 2025 and going into 2026, believing God for great finances for the household.
mentions.quote: believing God for great great great finances for your household
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: private household finances.
